## What would you like Xrotel to do?

Describe the feature or improvement.

## Which profile would benefit?

Efficient / Balanced / Power / Maximum / All

## What problem would this solve?

Explain the real-world development problem you're trying to solve.

## How would you expect it to behave?

Describe the ideal workflow from the user's perspective.

## Is this related to a new agent role?

Yes / No / Not sure

If yes, describe what responsibility that agent should have.

## Additional context

Examples, screenshots, workflow ideas, or other information.
